name: Caccetta–Häggkvist conjecture
question: Does minimum digraph outdegree r force a directed cycle of length at most ceil(n/r)?
first_attack: Prior-art-first independent verification of 2026 fixed-outdegree-6 proof claim and smaller independent exact-degree SAT encoding; no full-conjecture proof claimed
method_title: Replay the object, or mine the census
dispatch_next: Replay the external fixed-r=6 proof corpus on an independent host, verify its published hash and proof traces, and audit the hand-reduction steps before launching duplicate SAT search.
dispatch_why: The fixed-r=6 corpus is published and hashed, and this repository has not replayed its proof traces.

campaign.hypothesis: For each explicit pair (n,r), any loopless n-vertex digraph of minimum outdegree at least r contains a directed cycle of length at most ceil(n/r).
campaign.first_proof_obligation: Independently audit the public computer-assisted fixed-r=6 proof claim, including proof-to-CNF reductions, finite certificates and cited premises; distinguish restricted result from full CH.
campaign.next_experiment: Replay the external fixed-r=6 proof corpus on an independent host, verify its published hash and proof traces, and audit the hand-reduction steps before launching duplicate SAT search.
campaign.falsification: An explicitly checked digraph with min outdegree r and no directed cycle of length <=ceil(n/r).
campaign.blocker: External fixed-r=6 proof corpus (438 MB) and independent specialist review have not been reproduced in this repo; neither encoding supplies a SAT/UNSAT certificate.

milestones.title: Caccetta–Häggkvist verified on all digraphs of size at most five
milestones.scope: Every labeled loopless directed graph on 2–5 vertices (known finite cases only), checked modulo relabeling
milestones.description: Exhaustive n=5 census: 2^20=1,048,576 labeled graphs partition into 9,608 isomorphism orbits (matching Burnside and OEIS A000273); two independent cycle detectors agree. Known result only.

formal_statement.encodes: Loopless digraph on n vertices, minimum out-degree ≥ r ≥ 1, has an injective directed cycle of length ≤ ⌈n/r⌉; StatementFor r fixes the out-degree slice.
not_encoded: The triangle case r = n/3 separately

external_claims.claim_scope: All finite loopless digraphs with minimum outdegree >=6 satisfy the Caccetta–Häggkvist girth bound (restricted fixed-r case).
external_claims.note: Checksums copied from source README, NOT independently downloaded or replayed in Svyable/100.
